notes.title: HORROR CAM - Update V 1.5 - New Features
notes.content:
[h2][b]THE DESCENT UPDATE V 1.5[/b][/h2]

Happy New Year! This update offers [b]FREE NEW CONTENT[/b] offering NEW features asked by the community + Polish to improve the experience even further. [b]Please don't forget to review game and show your support, Thank you![/b]

[h3]Major[/h3]

[list]
[*] [b]NEW HORROR CAM[/b] - New Post Process Lens FX + Dust Scratches + Wide Angle Lens + Lightbloom + GrainFX offers a horror style cam effect. Great look for spectators.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44773651/83ed951d0f0e5cadd53edec9de0ab65e4f6135ed.jpg[/img]

notes.title: 'The Descent' Launches on Steam.
notes.content:
Embark on a Descent into Darkness: 'The Descent' Launches on Steam. Unravel Mysteries, Confront Horrors, and Navigate the Treacherous Mines!"

Hey there. I just wanted to share with you that my new game The Descent has launched on Steam!

Thank you very much to the beta testers who have made this game even better with their assistance; your names are included in the credits. We look forward to receiving your feedback, so please share it with us. If you encounter any issues, kindly inform us in the forums, and we will promptly address any bugs or suggestions you might have. We hope you thoroughly enjoy the horror experience in The Descent.

THE DESCENT
Experience 'The Descent,' a first-person psychological horror walking sim, set in the late 19th century in the coal mining town of Rockwell Mine. Immerse yourself in the grueling lives of miners and their unsettling encounters deep within the treacherous mines. Assume the role of an investigator who returns to their hometown after law school to unveil its mysteries.

Rockwell Mine has been plagued by numerous accidents, disappearances, and unexplained deaths, leaving authorities baffled. Despite countless investigations, the truth remains elusive, leading to the closure of the mine to the public.

As a player, you must navigate the perilous mine, document your investigation with a camera, solve the mysteries behind the disappearances, and overcome obstacles while evading the dangers lurking within."

notes.title: Descend into Darkness Delayed: The Descent postponed to January 5.
notes.content:
[b]THE DESCENT DELAY[/b]

After careful consideration and in line with a suggestion from Steam to avoid overlapping with the Winter Sale, we have decided to adjust the release date. This decision was made to ensure that The Descent receives the attention it deserves without conflicting with other events in the gaming community.

This adjustment was not undertaken lightly, and we are confident that the additional time will enable us to refine and perfect every aspect of the game. This ensures that when you finally experience it firsthand, The Descent will surpass all expectations. Furthermore, the extended timeline grants us the opportunity to introduce a new [b]ghost[/b] mode; more details will be revealed at a later date.

[b]The New Release Date is Jan 5, 2024[/b]

We understand that this change might impact your plans, and we sincerely apologize for any inconvenience.

notes.title: Join The Descent Beta: Your Chance to Shape the Game!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44773651/7bb4bc7e22fa4f08539d638b24f36b3fbf091a5d.jpg[/img]

Exclusive Beta Access for 'The Descent': Dive into the Darkness Before Anyone Else!

Dear Tester,
We hope you are ready for an exciting adventure! We are thrilled to announce the beta release of our upcoming game, 'The Descent,' and you could be invited to be one of the first to experience the terror that awaits in the depths of Rockwell Mine.

Terms and Conditions:
Before applying for a beta test, please take note of the following:
You will not be able to post any game play footage or screenshots publicly.
This is a closed beta focused on gathering feedback for game improvement.
Beta will have a Start DATE and End DATE.
Please give Feedback submission right after the event so we can start working on the bugs and suggestions offered.
The Beta Keys will be Deleted after the event.

If you do not have the time please [b]don't[/b] apply.

[b]BETA DATES[/b]
START DATE:  [b]Dec 9[/b]
END DATE:  [b]Dec 17[/b]

How to Apply:
Email us back and tell us why you would like to help us and how. You agree to give us feedback for the game on a form provided when chosen.

[b]Email: thedescentvideogame@gmail.com[/b]
   
Reward
You will get a FREE KEY to the game upon release and a special thank you in the credits.

We appreciate your commitment to shaping 'The Descent' into a thrilling horror experience. Your feedback is crucial, and together, we can make this game exceptional.
